notes: CORE POSITION-SIZING LESSON. Formula: lot = (account*risk%)/(SL_pips*pip_value_per_lot), 2-decimal granularity. Worked examples: $1000/1%/30pips=0.03 lots ($10); $100k/1%/400pips=25 lots. Contract size (units/lot) MANDATORY per broker: Hankotrade=10, generic offshore=100. Risk tiers: normal=1%, de-risk=0.5% (half lot, used on news/holidays), confident=2% (double, FORBIDDEN for students). Set-lot lets realized risk float 1%->3% with stop width. Full-port forbidden. One-pair rule for beginners. All 8 files written. Completes the L37/L38/L39 risk-engine input triad.
